card.name: Concessive words like even and without
card.fires_on: Concessive or hedging words such as "even", "although" and "without" that come right before a statement that a limited case still carries an effect or risk.

modes.label: even + condition
modes.description: The word "even" introduces a mild or unlikely case that still has an effect.
modes.example: Intrathecal administration of ISOVUE,<< even>> if inadvertent, can cause death,

modes.label: not without risk
modes.description: The word "without" follows "is not" in a phrase saying something still carries risk.
modes.example: However, even short-term NSAID therapy is not<< without>> risk.

modes.label: Although clause
modes.description: A sentence-opening "Although" sets up a contrast with a limited fact.
modes.example: << Although>> his success lasted only a year and a

card.writes: It favors words like "only", "neither" and "nothing" and disfavors "at least" and "although", which suggests limiting or negating continuations.
card.plain: It marks words like "even" or "not without" that introduce a surprising small case that still matters.
